conditions: No dash, frozen status, or ability; full stick for field movement. Formula values, not measured play averages.
selector: FieldingResolver.AirMul uses preview.Grounder, preview.Line and fielding position, not current ball height. A bounce alone does not remove this multiplier at call sites retaining the preview.
fieldingAndRunningCalibration: Separate formulas use the same Run stat. No requirement that offense and defense have identical ft/s.
motionImplementation: Ordinary stick and StepToward integrate speed * dt after eligibility/lockout; no ordinary pursuit acceleration ramp. Special moves and handoff coast are separate.

acceptedDirections.scope: Pursuit movement contract only. Does not equate baserunning with fielding or select speed, acceleration, reaction delay, reach, or dimensions.
acceptedDirections.implementationGate: Replace modifiers only within a coherent compact geometry/flight/pursuit profile with gameplay validation; do not set both to 1 on current geometry.
acceptedDirections.direction: One ordinary pursuit movement profile per character, independent of hit class or assigned fielding position, retaining explicit dash/status/ability modifiers
acceptedDirections.alternativeConsideredNotSelected: Retain hit-class/position movement modifiers as deliberate calibration tools
acceptedDirections.basis: Jack answered yes to the consistent ordinary movement direction after the movement audit and tradeoff review.
